summary: Frontend-only re-test (desktop 1920x800) of the once-only Lab coach fix (LabTour storageKey 'mikilab_lab_tour_v2'), run both as guest and logged in as admin@mikilab.de. ALL 4 scenarios PASS. (1) Deep-link no longer burns the tour: with mikilab_lab_tour_v2 removed and mikilab_pending_tool='pianoai', clicking nav-tab-maestro paints [data-testid=lab-tour] (MutationObserver: node inserted at ~840ms) with the Mohammadreza card + Skip/Next, and the key becomes '1' only ~560ms AFTER the card was on screen (~1400ms), i.e. on the post-paint timer, not on mount. (2) Once-only on reload: with key='1', reload + return to the Lab/planner -> tour count 0. (3) Fresh landing entry (key removed, no pending_tool) -> tour appears once; reload -> does not reappear. (4) Regressions: stepping lab-tour-next then lab-tour-skip-2 closes the tour cleanly; tools-dir-tool-generatore opens the Recipe Generator with 'Back to tools'; theme (black/orange) intact; zero console/page errors (only expected 401s for auth-gated endpoints while browsing as guest).
critical_code_review_comments: LabTour.jsx: separate effect writes storageKey via a 500ms timeout cleared on unmount - correct fix; note the tour is marked seen after 500ms even if the user never interacts (acceptable, matches 'shown once' intent).
Residual note from iteration_134 (unfixed, low prio): ToolsDirectory search matches only the localized name, so cross-language queries return 'No tool found'.
seed_data_creation: None. Only localStorage keys touched (mikilab_newsletter_seen='1', mikilab_lab_tour_v2, mikilab_pending_tool).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once-only Lab coach fix verified fixed (iteration_134 bug closed). Measurement technique that works: inject a MutationObserver for [data-testid=lab-tour] plus a 25ms interval polling localStorage before clicking nav-tab-maestro; compare insert time vs key-set time (expect key ~500ms later). Login flow: header 'Sign in' button opens the auth screen; fill email+password and press Enter.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously the storageKey was written in the same effect that set step=0, so a transient mount (Maestro reading mikilab_pending_tool and switching view in the same commit) consumed the tour. The fix defers the write to a 500ms timeout in a dedicated effect (cleared on unmount), confirmed by the observed 840ms paint / 1400ms key-set gap.
